Subject: Request for latest penetration test covering Hosted API

Hi Aditya,

Hope youre well. GreenLeaf is in the middle of a security intake for an upcoming integration. Can you share the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwoods Hosted API and management console? We need:

- The executive summary and full findings (or a redacted version if the full report requires an NDA)
- Clarification on scope: does the report include the hosted control plane/console and the public API endpoints? Does it exclude Dedicated/Private deployments?
- A remediation tracker or status update for any critical/high findings, with ETA for outstanding fixes
- Preferred secure delivery method (SFTP, presigned S3 with MFA, secure Box/SharePoint) and any required paperwork (NDA, DPA amendment)

Wed like to review this week if possible. Procurement may also need an evidence link for our vendor assessment.

Thanks,
Sarah

Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test covering Hosted API

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline — happy to help. Looping in Mina (Security) and Laura (Trust) to confirm final scope and share logistics. Quick answers up front:

- Scope: our most recent test covers the Redwood Hosted API (public ingestion and generation endpoints) and the Redwood Console (control plane) in our hosted region us-west-2. It does not include Dedicated or Private (on-prem/VPC) deployments unless weve explicitly scoped a customer engagement.
- Report variants: we can provide a redacted PDF summary immediately; the full unredacted report requires an NDA and a short intake (standard for external pen testers).
- Delivery options: presigned S3 with 7-day expiry and optional IP restriction + MFA is our default. We can also arrange SFTP or a secure Box share if your procurement needs that.
- Remediation tracker: yes — we can provide a CSV tracker showing finding IDs, status (open/in-progress/resolved), and expected ETA.

Mina / Laura — can you confirm whether the redacted summary attached to this thread is good to share to GreenLeaf now and whether the remediation CSV is up-to-date? If procurement needs a DocuSign NDA before we share the full report, please say so and Ill coordinate.

Sarah — Ill aim to send a secure link + redacted report and remediation tracker within one business day once Mina confirms. If procurement prefers SFTP or a specific vendor portal, let me know and well accommodate.

Best,
Aditya Rao
